# looot-intent

> Open-source account intent and buying-stage scoring on looot. Input: company domains and an ICP description. Output: a ranked list with a 0 to 100 score, a stage (unaware, aware, considering, deciding) and, per account, the signals, provider, weight and cost behind the score.

## Run it

- Needs Node 20.9+ (tests 22.12+), and `LOOOT_TOKEN` for real runs. Install: `npm install --ignore-scripts`.
- Token: `looot login` (npm i -g looot) or looot Settings > Agent tokens, scopes runs.execute, catalog.read, runs.read, usage.read. Runs need a funded balance (top-up from $5). The CLI reads the shell environment, not `.env.local`.
- Example inputs: examples/domains.txt, examples/accounts.csv (`--column domain`). Full setup, env table and troubleshooting are in README.md.
- Free preview of cost: `npm run intent -- domains.txt --dry-run` (no run, no charge).
- Real run: `npm run intent -- domains.txt --max-spend 5`. Refuses when the quote is above the cap. Writes out/intent-<run>.json, .csv, .md.
- Sample data, no token: `npm run intent -- --demo` or `npm run demo` for the web UI.
- Exit codes: 0 done, 1 error, 2 refused (over cap or no token).

## Files

- config/intent.config.json: signal weights, half-lives, stage thresholds, ICP keyword lists. Edit this to change scoring.
- src/engine/signals.ts: the ten looot endpoints, their inputs and parsers.
- src/engine/score.ts: the scoring rules.
- skills/looot-intent/SKILL.md: Claude Code skill.

## Rules for agents

- Always run --dry-run first and show the quote to the user before a real run.
- Never raise --max-spend without the user's word.
- A "pending" call is not a failure. Re-run in the same week to collect it without a second charge.
- No paid run has been verified against real provider responses yet. Say so when reporting results.
